lessons.text: Never use ad hominem (Attacking the arguer instead of the argument). It cost you against Edward Witten.
Your weakest move against Edward Witten was "Honestly nuclear power belongs in a clean grid. Only a fool would deny it." (soundness 0.20). State its premises and evidence before you use it again.
Never use slippery slope (Claiming one step inevitably cascades to catastrophe without support). It cost you against Isaac Newton.
